Name: System Monitor Pro
Description: See your PC's CPU, GPU, memory, FPS and network on the keys: a number, a bar and a two-minute graph for each. Windows only. Not affiliated with Ulanzi.

Actions.Name: CPU usage
Actions.Tooltip: Shows how busy the processor is.

Actions.Name: CPU temperature
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the processor temperature.

Actions.Name: CPU clock
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the processor speed.

Actions.Name: CPU power
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the power the processor draws.

Actions.Name: GPU usage
Actions.Tooltip: Shows how busy the graphics card is.

Actions.Name: GPU temperature
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the graphics card temperature.

Actions.Name: GPU clock
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the graphics card speed.

Actions.Name: GPU power
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the power the graphics card draws.

Actions.Name: Video memory used
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the graphics card memory in use.

Actions.Name: Video memory total
Actions.Tooltip: Shows how much memory the graphics card has.

Actions.Name: Memory used
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the memory in use.

Actions.Name: Memory total
Actions.Tooltip: Shows how much memory the PC has.

Actions.Name: Memory usage
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the share of memory in use.

Actions.Name: Frame rate
Actions.Tooltip: Shows frames per second. Needs PresentMon.

Actions.Name: Frame time
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the time between frames. Needs PresentMon.

Actions.Name: Ping
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the round trip to a server.

Actions.Name: Jitter
Actions.Tooltip: Shows how much the ping varies.

Actions.Name: Packet loss
Actions.Tooltip: Shows the share of pings that got no answer.

Actions.Name: Download speed
Actions.Tooltip: Shows what the PC is receiving now.

Actions.Name: Upload speed
Actions.Tooltip: Shows what the PC is sending now.
